A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SAFE-SQL and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. All 13 pages of each version support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original SAFE-SQL evaluations on Spider and BIRD, component ablations, and appendix model-size and embedding analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark results and ablations in Tables 1–3, along with the empirical analyses in Appendices C and D.

M1.justification: Schema linking, ten-example generation, three-component relevance scoring, threshold-8 filtering, and final inference remain unchanged. Appendix B retains the same prompts.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Spider and BIRD development datasets. Difficulty coverage and the data used in the appendix analyses are unchanged.

E2.justification: SYN-SQL and SQL-PaLM no longer participate in the reported inference-time comparison: their Table 1 timing entries become dashes. Both remain accuracy comparators, and the other comparator memberships are unchanged.

E3.justification: Development splits, EX/EM metrics, model configurations, and generation/filtering settings are retained. No revised timing procedure is stated; Sense-13B and PaLM-2 are typographic updates to existing model names.

E4.justification: The component ablations, threshold and scoring-weight sensitivity tests, embedding analyses, generated-example case study, and appendix model-size analysis are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The correlation analysis and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 1 replaces SYN-SQL's inference time of 16.34 and SQL-Palm's 18.93 with dashes. Accuracy scores, remaining timing values, plotted results, and appendix results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The weighted relevance-score definition and threshold-based selection set in Equations (1)–(2) are mathematically unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about unsupervised self-augmentation, fine-grained filtering, avoiding additional training, and strong performance on difficult queries.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning reasoning paths, example diversity, relevance thresholds, and latency tradeoffs are retained. The limitations concerning domain generalization, computational resources, and complex queries are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B's prompts and the disclosed generation, scoring, and model settings are unchanged. No implementation, hardware, or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to schema linking, retrieval, synthetic-data methods, and in-context learning remain unchanged. SQL-Palm/SQL-PaLM denotes the same cited method.

P1.justification: v3 updates author punctuation and affiliation numbering, adds Hyunkyung Bae's NYU affiliation and email, and expands the funding acknowledgement. Limited spelling and model-name formatting edits accompany otherwise unchanged scientific prose and section order.

P2.justification: Figures 2–4 are enlarged, surrounding text reflows, and printed page numbers are removed. The same figures and tables are retained, with unchanged plotted content.

improvement.justification: Larger figures improve legibility, while removing the two SFT baseline timings reduces the documented efficiency comparison. Neither PDF explains whether those omissions correct unreliable comparisons or remove valid evidence. With the method, accuracy results, and appendix content otherwise unchanged, the net quality effect is uncertain.
